stem: A defoliation program increases cannabinoid concentration in one cultivar but not consistently in another, while floral-biomass responses also differ. Which conclusion is best supported?
choices: Canopy-management responses can be cultivar dependent, so results should be validated for the genotype and production goal rather than generalized as a universal prescription
Defoliation will increase cannabinoid concentration in every cultivar
Cultivar cannot influence response to canopy management
Any treatment that changes cannabinoid concentration must increase floral biomass
rationale: Recent controlled research found cultivar-dependent responses to defoliation, including differences in cannabinoid concentration and floral biomass. This supports genotype- and goal-specific evaluation rather than universal claims.
